name: Tile Game Ultimate [MARBLES]
desc:
Welcome to 🦑 Tile Game Ultimate 🦑 Parkour your way through the glass tiles to get to the very end! You can also roleplay as many different characters. With a cash prize that increases for every death, do you think you can reach the end and win?

📋 Update Log
-Throw a marble to determine if a tile can be stepped on or not (VIPs get 1 extra marble)
-Special tile tracker gamepass
-Number of wins before a reset has been nearly doubled

🏆 Premium Roblox users get 5,000 cash upon joining and a 1.1x cash multiplier 🏆
🛡️ Group Members get 5,000 bonus cash 🛡️

If you enjoy this game, be sure to play other games, like Fish Game, Hexa Game, Red Light Green Light, Squid Obby, 99% Fail, and many more.
